text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the hard work of spring and summer 
bearing fruit, Manhattan Cafe ran a 
brilliant race in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She, too, felt the confidence that she had 
gotten closer to her "friend" than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing no physical issues, her next goal 
is to catch up to her "friend"... To that 
end, she sets her sights on the year-end 
finale, the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Awaiting her on that grand stage were T.M. 
Opera O and Meisho Doto, who had been 
making waves in the Senior tier.
